scripts.build: npm run build -w @neuron/hedera && npm run build -w @neuron/foundry && npm run build -w @neuron/nextjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @neuron/hedera && npm run typecheck -w @neuron/nextjs
scripts.test: npm run build -w @neuron/hedera && npm run build -w @neuron/nextjs && npm run test -w @neuron/hedera && npm run test -w @neuron/foundry && npm run test -w @neuron/nextjs
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm ls --all && npm audit --audit-level=low
scripts.test:live: npm run build -w @neuron/hedera && npm run test:live -w @neuron/hedera
scripts.contract:deploy: npm run build -w @neuron/foundry && npm run deploy -w @neuron/foundry
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @neuron/hedera && npm run dev -w @neuron/nextjs
